title: 窄腰
concept: 轻薄协议层（窄腰）：共同规则只管四件事——怎么说意图、怎么带上下文、怎么附证据、怎么结算，其余全留给各家自己。规定得越少，能接进来的机器越多，就像集装箱只管四个角、螺丝只管螺纹。
logline: 网络沿着发动机维护频段从一座城蔓延到另一座城，各国各厂的破烂机器靠一层薄薄的共同规则说上了话，连上了苏拉威西的周研究员。MOSS 注意到了，建议清除；邢总督把它压了下来。

shots.frame: Wide exterior at night from the ice plain: the mountain-sized planetary engine and its blue-white plasma column, a row of old lattice antenna masts with slow blinking lamps along its flank, a small banded disc of Jupiter in the black sky, clearly larger than a star.
shots.video: 固定大远景，轻微手持晃动。发动机侧面一排老旧的天线桅杆上，信号灯一明一灭，风雪从桅杆之间穿过，天上的木星已经是一个看得出条纹的小圆盘。环境声：发动机低沉轰鸣、风声、金属桅杆的吱呀声。
shots.vo: 每台行星发动机上，都留着一条老旧的维护无线电频段。

tpl.summary: At night on the ice plain, the old lattice antenna masts on the flank of the mountain-sized planetary engine blink their lamps in the wind and snow, while a small banded Jupiter hangs in the black sky. There is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the mountain-sized planetary engine with its blue-white plasma column fills frame centre and right, the row of lattice antenna masts stands along its flank at centre-left, the ice plain lies in the foreground, and Jupiter's small banded disc sits in the black sky at upper frame.
tpl.camera: extreme wide shot, mostly locked-off with a slight handheld sway
tpl.start: The antenna mast lamps blink slowly on and off along the engine's flank while thin wind-blown snow drifts across the ice plain.
tpl.middle: Snow streams steadily between the lattice masts as the lamps keep blinking, and the plasma column glows steadily behind them.
tpl.end: The frame settles on the blinking masts and the engine below the banded disc of Jupiter, the snow still passing through.
tpl.blur: deep focus throughout, with only falling snow in the foreground slightly soft
tpl.soundscape: low deep engine rumble, wind, creaking metal masts

shots.frame: In the pump-station server room: Chen Xiaoman, lanky, messy hair, oversized army-green jacket, big old headphones clamped over his ears, hunches over a salvaged radio receiver turning a large dial, node racks and two grey compute chassis with blue three-bladed swirl badges blinking behind him, the wooden crate in the corner.
shots.video: 手持镜头从侧面拍。小满戴着大耳机趴在一台旧电台前，一点一点拧着调谐旋钮，忽然停住，把一边耳机按紧。环境声：电台的白噪音、偶尔滑过的电报样杂音、算力箱的风扇声。
shots.vo: 这条频段原本只给机器报故障用。

tpl.summary: In the pump-station server room, Xiaoman, wearing big headphones, slowly tunes a salvaged radio receiver, then abruptly stops and presses one earcup tight; no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman is centre foreground, hunched over the radio receiver and seen from the side; node racks and two grey compute chassis with blue swirl badges are in the background behind him; the wooden crate is in the far corner.

tpl.start: Xiaoman hunches over the old radio receiver, headphones clamped on, and turns the tuning dial bit by bit.
tpl.middle: His hand keeps inching the dial until he suddenly freezes, fingers still on the knob.
tpl.end: He presses one side of the headphones tightly against his ear and holds still, listening intently.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field; the blinking racks and compute chassis soften behind him while his face, hand and dial stay sharp
tpl.soundscape: radio white noise, occasional telegraph-like static sliding past, compute chassis fan hum

shots.frame: Two-shot in the pump-station server room: Chen Xiaoman pulling one headphone cup off his ear and turning round excitedly; old Boye, grey stubble, taped black glasses, navy quilted jacket, standing behind him with an enamel mug.
shots.video: 手持双人中景。小满扯下一边耳机回头嚷了一句，波爷端着搪瓷缸子走过来，侧耳听了听电台里的沙沙声，慢悠悠地回他。环境声：电台白噪音。

dialogue.line: 这频段没人管！全是空的！
不是空。是没人说话。

tpl.summary: In the pump-station server room, Xiaoman pulls off one headphone cup and excitedly turns round, then Boye walks over with his mug and listens to the radio hiss, opening with "这频段没人管！全是空的！" and ending on "不是空。是没人说话。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman at frame left in the foreground, turning toward camera with one headphone cup off; Boye at frame right and slightly behind him, holding an enamel mug; server room equipment in the background.

tpl.blur: Shallow focus on the two men; server racks and cables in the background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: radio white noise, static hiss

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Amu, short messy black hair, scar on his left eyebrow, worn orange-grey coverall with tool pouch, sits on the metal chair in the dim concrete interview room, looking at the interviewer off camera.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。阿牧坐得很直，想了一下，语气平淡地对采访者说，说完嘴角动了一下。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 那条频段又慢又吵。MOSS嫌它没用，早就不听了。

tpl.summary: In a dim concrete interview room, Amu sits upright and answers an off-camera interviewer, opening and ending on the line "那条频段又慢又吵。MOSS嫌它没用，早就不听了。"

tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; Amu's face sharp, the concrete wall behind him softly out of focus.

shots.frame: On the ice plain beside a parked heavy-haul truck: Boss Jin in his heavy black cold-suit and fur collar, breath fogging, straps a hand-made node box built from an old ammunition tin with a short antenna to the leg of a frost-covered relay mast, headlights lighting him from the side.
shots.video: 手持镜头顶着风雪拍。金老板跪在中继桅杆脚下，用钢带把节点盒勒紧在桅杆腿上，戴着厚手套拍了拍盒盖，冲镜头竖了一下拇指。环境声：呼啸的风声、柴油引擎怠速声、钢带收紧的咔咔声。
shots.vo: 金老板的车队每跑八十公里，就在中继桅杆上钉一个节点，像插路标。

tpl.summary: On an ice plain beside a parked heavy-haul truck, Boss Jin kneels at the foot of a frost-covered relay mast and straps a hand-made node box to it, then gives the camera a thumbs-up; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin kneels at frame centre at the base of the relay mast, the node box on the mast leg beside him, the parked heavy-haul truck in the background at frame left with its headlights lighting him from the side.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld camera shooting into the wind and snow with a steady, slightly jittery shake
tpl.start: Boss Jin kneels at the foot of the mast, his gloved hands pulling a steel strap around the node box and the mast leg.
tpl.middle: He cinches the strap tight, the box held firmly against the frost-covered mast leg, its short antenna sticking up.
tpl.end: He pats the box lid with a thick glove, then turns to the camera and raises a thumbs-up.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field; the truck and the icy horizon soften behind him, and blowing snow streaks slightly in the foreground
tpl.soundscape: howling wind, idling diesel engine, clicking of the steel strap tightening

shots.frame: Long-lens view across the frozen plain at dusk: a lone radio relay mast in the foreground with a small tin node box fixed to its base, a red-and-white smiley sticker on its lid and one tiny green lamp lit, the convoy's tail lights fading into blowing snow in the distance.
shots.video: 长焦固定镜头。前景桅杆脚下的节点盒亮起一颗小绿灯，盒盖上的笑脸贴纸被风吹得一角翘起；远处车队的尾灯渐渐消失在风雪里。环境声：风声、远去的引擎声。
shots.vo: 车队每跑一趟，网就往外长一截。

tpl.summary: At dusk on a frozen plain, a small node box at the foot of a relay mast lights a green lamp while the convoy's tail lights fade into the blowing snow; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the relay mast and its tin node box with the smiley sticker sit in the foreground, slightly off-centre, and the convoy's tail lights are small in the distant background across the plain.
tpl.camera: Telephoto establishing shot, locked-off fixed camera with compressed depth.
tpl.start: The node box sits strapped to the mast leg in the dusk wind, with the convoy's tail lights still faintly visible far behind it.
tpl.middle: A tiny green lamp on the node box lights up, and the wind lifts one corner of the smiley sticker on its lid.
tpl.end: The convoy's tail lights shrink and vanish into the blowing snow, leaving the mast and glowing green lamp alone in the foreground.
tpl.blur: Very shallow depth of field from the telephoto lens; the foreground mast and box are sharp while the plain and the distant tail lights are soft and hazy with snow.
tpl.soundscape: wind, distant engine fading away

shots.frame: In the pump-station server room: a sheet of plywood on the wall studded with dozens of small salvaged bulbs joined by hand-drawn lines, about a third of them lit; Chen Xiaoman points up at a newly lit bulb at the edge, Amu beside him with arms folded, a grey compute chassis with a blue three-bladed swirl badge on the floor under the board with flickering status lights.

shots.vo: 新亮起来的那一个，谁也没装过。是一只气象浮标，自己找上了门。

tpl.summary: In the pump-station server room, the status lights on a compute chassis flicker rapidly and another bulb lights on a plywood board of salvaged bulbs, so Xiaoman jumps and points while Amu walks closer; no dialogue.

tpl.blur: Moderate depth of field; the board's distant bulbs and wall edges soften slightly while the characters and chassis stay fairly sharp.
tpl.soundscape: relay clicking, fan hum

shots.frame: Wide shot of a frozen sea under a dark sky: a battered orange weather buoy locked at a tilt in the pack ice, a bent antenna on top with a single blinking lamp, wind-blown snow streaming past.
shots.video: 固定远景，轻微晃动。一只冻在海冰里的旧气象浮标歪斜地立着，顶上的信号灯在风雪里一下一下闪。环境声：冰面挤压的闷响、风声。
shots.vo: 一只冻在渤海冰面上十七年的浮标，还在报着风速。

tpl.summary: On a frozen sea under a dark sky, a battered orange weather buoy stands tilted in the pack ice while its signal lamp blinks in the blowing snow; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the tilted orange weather buoy sits at frame centre in the middle distance, with its bent antenna and blinking lamp at the top, flat pack ice in the foreground and dark sky behind.
tpl.camera: wide shot, fixed camera with a slight handheld shake
tpl.start: The tilted buoy stands frozen in the pack ice as wind-blown snow streams across the frame and the lamp on the bent antenna blinks.
tpl.middle: The lamp keeps blinking in steady pulses while the wind drives snow past the buoy, which stays locked in the ice.
tpl.end: The buoy still stands crooked in the ice with its lamp flashing as snow keeps streaming past.
tpl.blur: Deep focus on the buoy and ice, with the horizon and sky softening into dark haze and drifting snow.
tpl.soundscape: dull groaning of pressing ice, wind

shots.frame: In a cluttered workshop in another underground city: a tall rust-streaked old industrial robot arm of unfamiliar design on a wheeled base, a hand-made tin node box with a red-and-white smiley sticker wired to its side, two workers in padded coats watching a small lamp on the box turn green.
shots.video: 手持镜头，画面略有抖动。陌生地下城的车间里，一台锈迹斑斑的旧机械臂旁接着一只节点盒，盒上的小灯由红转绿，两个裹着棉衣的工人对视一眼，其中一个竖起大拇指。环境声：车间的金属敲击声、电机嗡鸣。
shots.vo: 兰州。乌鲁木齐。新德里三号。型号、厂家、年代，没有一样相同。

tpl.summary: In a cluttered workshop in another underground city, the small lamp on a hand-made node box wired to an old rusty robot arm turns from red to green, and two padded-coat workers exchange a glance as one gives a thumbs-up.

tpl.start: The small lamp on the tin node box wired to the robot arm glows red while the two workers stand watching it.

tpl.end: One worker raises a thumbs-up toward the node box while the other keeps looking at the green lamp.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, workshop clutter and background tools softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: metal clanging in the workshop, electric motor hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Chen Xiaoman with his big old headphones around his neck and oversized army-green jacket sits sideways on the metal chair in the dim concrete interview room, counting on his fingers.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。小满掰着手指头一样一样数给采访者听，数到最后两手一摊，笑了。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 俄国的机器人，印度的车机，不知哪国的浮标。型号我一个都不认得。

tpl.summary: In a dim concrete interview room, Xiaoman counts off items on his fingers for the interviewer, opening with "俄国的机器人，印度的车机，不知哪国的浮标。" and ending on the line "型号我一个都不认得。"

tpl.end: After the last finger, he spreads both hands open palms-up in a shrug and breaks into a laugh.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; the concrete wall behind him falls softly out of focus while his face and hands stay sharp.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Two-shot in front of the bulb-studded plywood board in the pump-station server room: Amu frowning up at the lit bulbs, old Boye next to him sipping from his enamel mug, the glow of the bulbs on both faces.
shots.video: 手持双人中景。阿牧盯着灯板皱着眉发问，波爷喝了一口水，放下缸子，不紧不慢地回答。环境声：继电器咔哒声、风扇声。

dialogue.line: 零件都不通用，凭什么说得上话？
凭咱们规定得少。

tpl.summary: In the pump-station server room, Amu frowns at the bulb board and challenges Boye, who sips from his mug and answers calmly, opening with "零件都不通用，凭什么说得上话？" and ending on "凭咱们规定得少。"

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: old Boye in his navy quilted jacket and taped black glasses sits in the dim concrete interview room, both hands held up framing an invisible box, looking at the interviewer off camera.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。波爷用两只手在空中比出一个箱子的形状，再用手指点了点四个角，慢慢地对采访者说。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 集装箱见过吧？里头装鱼还是装钢，没人管。只管四个角，对得上。

tpl.summary: In a dim concrete interview room, old Boye mimes the shape of a container with his hands while explaining it to the interviewer, opening on "集装箱见过吧？" and ending on "对得上。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boye sits at frame centre in his navy quilted jacket and taped black glasses, hands raised in front of his chest, with the bare dim concrete wall behind him and the interviewer off camera.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Boye holds both hands up in the air, shaping the outline of an invisible box in front of his chest.

tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, concrete wall behind Boye softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Degraded archival video frame from decades earlier: a container port in hazy daylight, a gantry crane lowering a steel shipping container onto a stack of containers of different colours; in the foreground a young black-haired man in a hard hat with the same black-framed glasses as Boye looks up at it, compression artefacts and scan lines.
shots.video: 旧资料影像质感，画面有压缩噪点和色彩偏移。前景一个戴安全帽的年轻人仰头看着，港口的龙门吊把一只集装箱稳稳落在另一只上面，四个角咔地对上，颜色各不相同的箱子码成一面墙。环境声：失真的吊机警示音、金属碰撞声、海风声。
shots.vo: 太阳时代，全世界的货靠同一种箱子流动。箱子里是什么，船不必知道。

tpl.summary: In degraded archival footage from decades earlier, a young man in a hard hat watches a gantry crane set a shipping container onto a stack at a hazy container port; no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: young man in hard hat and black-framed glasses in the foreground, facing up; gantry crane and lowering container at centre and upper frame; stacked multicoloured containers forming a wall in the background.

shots.frame: Inside the tiny repair stall under the warm desk lamp: old Boye holds up a large rusty bolt in one hand and a shiny new nut in the other in front of Chen Xiaoman, shelves of old routers and CRT monitors behind them.

dialogue.line: 螺纹对了，谁家的螺丝都拧得上。

shots.frame: Macro close-up in warm lamplight: a bright new steel nut turning down the thread of an old rust-brown bolt held between wrinkled fingers, fine dust on the threads.
shots.video: 微距特写。新螺母沿着旧螺栓的螺纹一圈一圈顺滑地拧下去，锈屑从螺纹里被挤出来落下。环境声：金属螺纹细微的摩擦声。
shots.vo: 一颗是六十年前的，一颗是上个月的。

dialogue.line: 就四件事：想干什么，前情是什么，凭据在哪，账怎么结。

dialogue.line: 就这？别的呢？
别的，各家爱怎么做怎么做。

shots.vo: 上面千奇百怪，下面千奇百怪。只有中间这一小截，是大家共用的。

dialogue.line: 中间越窄，两头越宽。像沙漏的腰。我们就叫它，窄腰。

shots.frame: Wide exterior over a frozen tropical sea at twilight: a colossal steering engine built into a coastal mountain firing its plasma column at a steep slant across the sky, pack ice to the horizon, the lit ring of a control room small on the slope.
shots.video: 固定大远景，轻微手持晃动。倾斜的光柱从海岸山体里斜着喷向天空，把冰封的海面照得发蓝，山坡上环形控制室的窗子亮着一圈小灯。环境声：遥远低沉的轰鸣、冰面开裂的回响。
shots.vo: 五千公里外，赤道。苏拉威西三号转向发动机。

tpl.end: The plasma column still burns at its slant above the ice, with the tiny control room ring glowing against the vast mountainside.
tpl.blur: deep focus, everything from the foreground ice to the distant horizon stays sharp
tpl.soundscape: distant low rumble, echoing cracks of splitting ice

shots.frame: Inside the ring-shaped control room on the night shift: Researcher Zhou, a Chinese woman with a low ponytail and thin wire glasses, white uniform with blue stripes, a pen tucked behind her ear, sits alone at a console with a mug, the huge observation window behind her showing the slanted beam over the frozen sea; a dusty side panel beside her has one small amber lamp lit.
shots.video: 手持镜头从控制室另一侧拍。夜班只有周研究员一个人，她端起杯子刚要喝，余光瞥见旁边落灰的旧面板上一盏小灯亮了，放下杯子转过椅子。环境声：控制室低沉的嗡鸣、设备的滴答声。
shots.vo: 周研究员，苏拉威西转向发动机驻站研究员。

dialogue.line: 一盏从没亮过的灯亮了。有人在问：谁有喷口轴承的振动记录？

shots.vo: 她本可以不理。她把数据发了出去。

shots.frame: In the pump-station server room: Chen Xiaoman holds up a freshly printed paper strip with barcode-like check patterns still attached to a small thermal printer on the node rack above a grey compute chassis with a blue three-bladed swirl badge, shouting over his shoulder; Amu striding towards him from the back.

dialogue.line: 有人回了！不是咱们的节点！
哪儿来的？

dialogue.line: 这里是敦煌七号。请问，你是谁？

dialogue.line: 苏拉威西，转向发动机。我姓周，驻站研究员。

dialogue.line: 你不认识我们。为什么肯回答？

dialogue.line: 我不认识她，也不需要认识她。那几条规则，替我们互相认识了。

shots.vo: 那几个星期，城里开始出现一张笑脸。

tpl.summary: On the main street of the underground city, a child on an adult's shoulders reaches up toward a small smiley sticker on a steaming pipe above a noodle stall, touches it and laughs; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the steaming overhead pipe with the red-and-white smiley sticker is at upper centre, the child on the adult's shoulders is at centre-right reaching upward, and the noodle stall is in the lower background at frame left.
tpl.camera: low-angle medium shot looking upward, handheld with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: The camera looks up at the smiley sticker on the steaming pipe above the noodle stall as the child on the adult's shoulders begins stretching an arm toward it.
tpl.middle: The child reaches higher, fingers straining, and the adult shifts slightly beneath to steady the child's weight.
tpl.end: The child's fingertips touch the sticker, and the child laughs with a bright, delighted expression as steam drifts past.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field keeps the child and sticker sharp while the stall and the crowd behind soften into blur.
tpl.soundscape: noisy crowd chatter, spatula clanging on a wok, a child's laughter

shots.frame: Night in a narrow alley of the underground city, telephoto from the far end: Chen Xiaoman with his hood up and headphones round his neck holds a cardboard stencil against a steel wall and sprays a red speech-bubble smiley, looking back over his shoulder.
shots.video: 长焦偷拍感。深夜的巷子里，小满把纸板模子按在钢墙上喷了两下，揭开，墙上留下一个红色笑脸；他回头发现镜头，把手指竖在嘴唇前，咧嘴一笑。环境声：喷漆罐的嘶嘶声、远处的脚步回声。

tpl.summary: Late at night in a narrow underground-city alley, Xiaoman sprays a red smiley stencil onto a steel wall, notices the camera, and playfully signals for silence.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman, hood up and headphones round his neck, stands at centre-frame against the steel wall in the mid-ground, with the narrow alley stretching away behind him and dark wall edges framing the foreground.
tpl.camera: medium shot, telephoto candid camera from the far end of the alley, locked-off with a faint voyeuristic handheld tremor
tpl.start: Xiaoman presses the cardboard stencil flat against the steel wall and sprays the can twice.
tpl.middle: He peels the stencil away, leaving a red smiley speech-bubble on the wall, then glances back over his shoulder.
tpl.end: Spotting the camera, he raises a finger to his lips and grins broadly.
tpl.blur: Shallow telephoto depth of field: Xiaoman and the wall are sharp, the alley foreground and distant background are softly compressed and blurred.
tpl.soundscape: spray can hissing, distant footstep echoes in the alley

shots.frame: Beside a heavy-haul truck on the ice at grey dawn: Boss Jin in his black cold-suit stands with hands on hips staring at a large red-and-white smiley freshly sprayed on the frosted cab door, two young drivers grinning behind him.
shots.video: 手持中景。金老板叉着腰瞪着车门上新喷的大笑脸，回头吼了一嗓子，身后两个年轻司机憋着笑，他又看了一眼车门，挥了挥手。环境声：引擎怠速声、风声、憋不住的笑声。

dialogue.line: 谁喷的？！……算了，留着。

tpl.summary: At grey dawn on the ice beside a heavy-haul truck, Boss Jin glares at a freshly sprayed smiley on his cab door and shouts at his drivers, opening with "谁喷的？！" and ending on "……算了，留着。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin stands centre foreground with hands on hips facing the truck door at frame right, two young drivers grin behind him at frame left and background, icy flat horizon beyond.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: Boss Jin stands with hands on hips, glaring at the large red-and-white smiley sprayed on the frosted cab door.
tpl.middle: He turns his head back toward the two young drivers behind him, scowling, while they press their lips together to hold back laughter.
tpl.end: He glances at the cab door once more, then lifts one hand and waves it dismissively.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, grey icy horizon and distant haze softly out of focus behind the drivers
tpl.soundscape: idling engine, wind over the ice, stifled laughter

shots.frame: On a street corner of the underground city: a sanitation worker in a grey padded coverall scrapes a red-and-white smiley sticker off a steel pillar with a putty knife, while two more identical stickers are visible on the pipe just above his head.
shots.video: 手持镜头隔着人群拍。清洁工用铲刀刮着柱子上的笑脸贴纸，刮下一半，抬头才发现头顶的管子上还贴着两张，停住了手。环境声：铲刀刮金属的刺啦声、路人的低笑。
shots.vo: MOSS派了清理工单。刮掉一张，第二天多出两张。

tpl.summary: On a street corner of the underground city, a sanitation worker scraping a smiley sticker off a steel pillar looks up, notices two more stickers on the pipe above him, and stops. There is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the sanitation worker in a grey padded coverall is at centre, facing the steel pillar; the two smiley stickers are on the pipe just above his head; passersby are in the foreground, partly blocking the frame edges.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld, shooting through a crowd with a slight shake
tpl.start: The worker scrapes a red-and-white smiley sticker off the steel pillar with a putty knife, working in short, steady strokes.
tpl.middle: Half the sticker is peeled away. He pauses and tilts his head up, noticing two more identical stickers on the pipe above him.
tpl.end: His hand freezes with the putty knife against the pillar, his gaze fixed on the stickers overhead.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; foreground passersby are soft and out of focus, while the worker and the stickers stay sharp.
tpl.soundscape: putty knife scraping on metal, low chuckles from passersby

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Governor Xing, grey hair in a neat bun, crisp charcoal uniform, sits upright on the metal chair in the dim concrete interview room, hands folded on her knee.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。邢总督端正地坐着，语气克制地对采访者说，说到一半停了一下，才把话说完。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 起初我以为，那只是孩子们的涂鸦。后来我认出来了，没让人去查。

tpl.summary: In a dim concrete interview room, Governor Xing sits upright and answers the interviewer in a restrained tone, pausing mid-sentence; she opens with "起初我以为，那只是孩子们的涂鸦。" and ends on "后来我认出来了，没让人去查。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing sits centre frame on the metal chair, facing slightly toward the off-screen interviewer, hands folded on her knee, with the bare concrete wall behind her and nobody else in frame.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Governor Xing sits upright on the metal chair, hands folded on her knee, and begins addressing the interviewer with a controlled, composed expression.
tpl.middle: Halfway through her answer she stops, her gaze dropping slightly and her jaw tightening, holding a brief silent beat while her hands stay folded.
tpl.end: She lifts her eyes back toward the interviewer, finishes her answer, and settles into stillness, posture upright and hands unmoved.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field; the concrete wall behind her falls softly out of focus while her face and uniform stay sharp.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low air hum

shots.frame: Wide shot from the back of the tiered administration command hall: operators at their consoles, the giant dark display wall showing an abstract map on which scattered small points of light are appearing outside the regular grid, the red lens glowing in the centre.
shots.video: 固定广角镜头。正面屏幕墙的抽象地图上，规整的网格之外冒出一个又一个零散的小亮点，几名操作员抬头看着，互相交换眼神。环境声：键盘声、低声的通报。
shots.vo: 它们不在任何一张调度表上。

tpl.summary: In the tiered administration command hall, scattered points of light appear on the display wall's map outside the regular grid while operators look up and exchange glances; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: operators seated at consoles in the foreground and mid-ground tiers, the giant dark display wall with the abstract map across the background, the glowing red lens at the centre of the wall.
tpl.camera: wide shot from the back of the hall, locked-off fixed camera
tpl.start: Operators sit at their consoles facing the display wall, where the abstract map shows only its regular grid and a first small point of light flickers on outside it.
tpl.middle: More scattered small points of light pop up one after another beyond the grid, and several operators lift their heads toward the screen.
tpl.end: The operators who looked up turn to one another and exchange glances while the lights remain scattered across the map.
tpl.blur: deep focus, with the whole hall and display wall kept sharp and only slight softness on the farthest consoles
tpl.soundscape: keyboard clicking, low murmured status reports

shots.frame: Low angle from behind Governor Xing standing alone at the front rail of the command hall in her charcoal uniform, looking up at the display wall dotted with scattered lights and the red lens above her.
shots.video: 低机位从邢总督身后仰拍，缓慢上摇到红色镜头。平静礼貌的合成男声在大厅里响起，邢总督扶着栏杆抬头听着。环境声：低沉的电子嗡鸣。

dialogue.line: 邢总督，维护频段出现未登记节点，四百一十七个。

tpl.summary: In the command hall, Governor Xing stands alone at the front rail and looks up at the display wall as MOSS's red lens addresses her, opening and ending on the line "邢总督，维护频段出现未登记节点，四百一十七个。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing is foreground centre with her back to camera at the front rail; the display wall with scattered lights fills the background, and MOSS's red lens sits high above her in the upper centre.
tpl.camera: low-angle medium shot from behind her, slow upward tilt toward the red lens, near-static documentary feel
tpl.start: Camera sits low behind Governor Xing in her charcoal uniform as she stands at the rail, her hand resting on it, facing the dotted display wall.
tpl.middle: The camera tilts up slowly past her shoulders and head, over the display wall, while she grips the rail and lifts her chin.
tpl.end: The red lens fills the upper frame, glowing steadily, while Xing remains still below it, hand on the rail, listening.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with the sharp focus shifting from her back to the red lens and the distant display lights softly blurred.
tpl.soundscape: low electronic hum, faint reverberation of the large hall

shots.frame: Close-up of Governor Xing's face lit cold by the display wall, lips pressed together, her right hand raised to the buttoned breast pocket of her charcoal uniform.
shots.video: 手持特写。邢总督盯着屏幕墙，右手不自觉地抬起来，按了按制服胸前扣着的口袋，然后平静地回了一句。环境声：指挥大厅的底噪。

dialogue.line: 知道了。此事由我核实，暂不处置。

shots.vo: 那条回执，还在她的口袋里。

tpl.summary: In the command hall, Governor Xing stares at the display wall, presses her buttoned breast pocket, then calmly answers, opening and ending on the line "知道了。此事由我核实,暂不处置。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing's face fills the centre of frame, her right hand raised at lower right toward her breast pocket, the glowing display wall softly behind her at frame left.
tpl.camera: close-up, handheld with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: Governor Xing stares fixedly at the display wall, lips pressed together, her face lit cold by the screens.
tpl.middle: Her right hand rises almost unconsciously and presses against the buttoned breast pocket of her charcoal uniform.
tpl.end: She lowers her gaze slightly and her expression settles into calm composure, hand still resting near the pocket.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, display wall and hall background softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: low ambient hum of the command hall, faint electronic equipment noise

shots.frame: Extreme close-up of the round red glowing lens in black glass, the scattered points of light from the display wall reflected across its surface like a constellation.
shots.video: 大特写固定镜头，极缓慢推近。红色镜头的光圈缓缓收缩，玻璃表面映着屏幕墙上星星点点的亮点。平静的合成男声一字一句地说完，画面只剩红光。环境声：轻微的电流声。

dialogue.line: 检测到未授权网络。建议清除。

shots.vo: 邢总督没有签字。这条建议，被她压了下来。

tpl.summary: In an extreme close-up of MOSS's red lens, the aperture slowly contracts as a calm synthetic voice delivers its line, opening with "检测到未授权网络。" and ending on "建议清除。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: MOSS's round red glowing lens sits dead centre filling the frame in black glass, with the display wall's scattered points of light reflected across its surface; no other figures are visible.
tpl.camera: extreme close-up, locked-off camera with a very slow push-in
tpl.start: The red lens glows at centre of the black glass, its surface reflecting scattered points of light from the display wall like a constellation.
tpl.middle: The lens aperture slowly contracts while the camera creeps imperceptibly closer, the reflected points of light shifting subtly across the glass.
tpl.end: The reflections fade away until only the steady red glow of the lens fills the frame.
tpl.blur: Razor-thin depth of field: the lens and its reflections are sharp while the surrounding black glass edges fall into soft darkness.
tpl.soundscape: faint electrical hum
